Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT actor_id
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
customers_renting AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) as customers
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_5_actors)
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM customer
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(c.customers AS FLOAT) / t.total * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM customers_renting c, total_customers t
